## About

I am a Senior Business Analyst specialising in regulated banking data platforms, regulatory reporting pipelines, and data governance frameworks within tier-1 financial institutions.

My experience spans Financial Markets, Risk, Finance, and Regulatory Reporting environments operating under intensive supervisory scrutiny. These environments demand demonstrable data lineage, aggregation integrity, reconciliation discipline, and control evidence across complex front-to-back systems.

In practice, this means working within regulatory frameworks that require traceability, consistent data definitions, and auditable transformation logic across domains.

Across roles, I have operated at the intersection of business, data, and technology. My work has focused on:

- End-to-end data lineage and aggregation analysis  
- Regulatory reporting transformations and platform migrations  
- Definition of governed data structures and validation controls  
- Translation of regulatory and business requirements into executable delivery specifications  
- Cross-domain impact analysis across Risk, Finance, and Treasury systems  
- Functional understanding of banking products and their data representation across front-to-back architectures  

I am particularly interested in the industrialisation challenge facing banks today: building data foundations robust enough to support both regulatory scrutiny and AI-driven decision systems.

My focus is on the structural conditions that allow complex data and AI systems to operate safely, transparently, and at scale in regulated environments.

### What I write about

- AI readiness in banking  
- Data contract and schema governance patterns  
- Production failure modes in reporting pipelines  
- Ownership and control frameworks for regulated data systems  
- Architecture considerations for AI under supervisory constraints
